retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist portrait featuring a central figure on a throne surrounded by iridescent textures and glowing neon tube lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, saturated portrait of a man seated on a sequined throne, framed by iridescent foil and floral arrangements, anchored by large, glowing neon-style typography in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure seated on a throne as the primary focal point
Layered neon typography overlapping the lower third of the subject
Iridescent, reflective background creating complex light play
Contrast between cool blue and warm orange neon light sources
coreInvariants: Glowing neon tube effect on all display text
Iridescent or metallic foil background texture
High-saturation color palette with deep shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, seated, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange neon text at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the blue neon text, and settle on the large orange neon base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with textures, flowers, and light effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and purples in the shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan and magenta reflections from the iridescent foil.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Glowing orange and electric blue from the neon typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast between neon highlights and deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Double-line stroke to simulate glass neon tubes
Outer glow effect matching the stroke color
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'P' and 'R' feature open loops or extended tails to mimic bent glass tubes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked hierarchy using contrasting neon colors (Blue over Orange) to separate title elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the physical bent-glass look of the lettering.
A digital font that mimics the rounded, monolinear neon style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with curly hair and glasses, wearing a blue and white patterned shirt, seated on a silver sequined throne. The background should be draped in iridescent green and silver mylar foil with purple orchids and lit candles on the sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two rows of custom neon lettering in the foreground. The top row should be electric blue with a double-line tube effect. The bottom row should be larger, in neon orange, also with a double-line tube effect and a strong outer glow.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a double-line neon tube effect?
Is the background iridescent and highly reflective?
Is the subject centered and seated on a throne?
Are the colors vibrant and high-contrast?

postGenerationChecks: Check for neon glow bleed onto the subject
Ensure text legibility despite the glow
Confirm central symmetry of the composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Iridescent Mylar + Sequined Throne + Stacked Neon Tube Typography
